name_en: Roti bakar kaya mentega (kaya butter toast)
intro: Two slices of roti bakar kaya mentega are about 300 kcal (estimate). The calories come from white bread, sweet kaya and butter.

variants.name: Roti bakar set with 2 half-boiled eggs
Roti bakar with kaya only, no butter

diet: Yes, 300 kcal for breakfast is actually not much. The problem is it's low in protein, so you get hungry again fast. Pair it with half-boiled eggs to stay full longer. Watch your sweet drinks too.
tips: Order the set with half-boiled eggs for protein.
Choose kopi or teh kosong, or kurang manis.
Ask for thin butter, or kaya only.

swap.name: 1 slice roti bakar kaya + 2 half-boiled eggs
swap.why: About the same calories but more protein, so you stay full until lunch.

faq.a: Kaya is made from eggs, santan, sugar and pandan leaves. There's the green Nyonya kaya and the brown Hainanese kaya.

faq.q: Is charcoal-toasted bread different from normal toast?
faq.a: Charcoal toast is crispier and has a smoky aroma. Calories are about the same.

faq.q: Why is the butter so thick at kopitiams?
faq.a: Kopitiams usually use a cold slab of butter for the texture. You can ask for less butter if you want.
